about: The Recreation.gov rollout, split into batches a child session builds alone (owner, 2026-10-08: "orchestrate the rest of rec.gov maps, each batch to a child"). Each batch is waves of one OpenStreetMap extract region (or the OSM API), so a child downloads one extract. The orchestrating session merges each batch, makes the final check, and records pass or hold. Brief: docs/design/campground-maps-rollout-child.md.
